title: Terse.jl
text:
Installation
Terse.jl provides the @types macro for defining Julia type hierarchies concisely.

title: Terse.jl
text:
Quickstart

using Terse

@types Shape > (
    Circle(radius::Float64),
    Rectangle(width::Float64, height::Float64)
)

@show supertype(Circle), supertype(Rectangle)
Circle(1.0), Rectangle(3.0, 4.0)

(supertype(Circle), supertype(Rectangle)) = (Main.Notebook.Shape, Main.Notebook.Shape)


(Circle(radius=1.0), Rectangle(width=3.0, height=4.0))


See Getting Started for a full overview of all supported syntax forms.

title: Getting Started
Getting Started
text:
Abstract Type with Subtypes
Use > to define an abstract type and its concrete subtypes together:

@types Animal > (
    Cat(lives::Int),
    Dog(name::String)
)

supertype(Cat), supertype(Dog)

(Animal, Animal)



Cat(9), Dog("Rex")

(Cat(lives=9), Dog(name="Rex"))

title: Getting Started
text:
Parametric Types
Type parameters and bounds work as normal Julia syntax inside {}:

@types Envelope{T} > (
    Plain{T}(value::T),
    Labelled{T, S <: AbstractString}(value::T, label::S)
)

Labelled{Int, String}(42, "answer")

Labelled{Int64, String}(value=42, label="answer")

title: Getting Started
text:
Nested Hierarchies
A subtype can itself be an abstract type with its own subtypes by using > again:

@types Animal2{T} > (
    Mammal{T}(family::T),
    Invertebrate{T} > (
        Worm{T}(),
        Insect{T, I <: Integer}(legs::I, family::T)
    )
)

supertype(Invertebrate{Float64}), supertype(Worm{Float64})

(Animal2{Float64}, Invertebrate{Float64})



Worm{String}(), Insect{Float64, Int8}(6, 1.0)

(Worm{String}, Insect{Float64, Int8}(legs=6, family=1.0))

title: Getting Started
text:
Abstract vs. Concrete
Parentheses decide whether a name becomes an abstract type or a concrete struct — the same rule at the top level and inside a hierarchy. A bare name is abstract and inherits the parent’s type parameters when it declares none; empty parentheses give a zero-field struct:

@types Tree > (
    Branch,      # abstract type Branch <: Tree end
    Leaf(),      # struct Leaf <: Tree end
)

isabstracttype(Branch), isabstracttype(Leaf)

(true, false)


Branch can then be extended later, either with another @types block or with <::

@types Twig(length::Float64) <: Branch
supertype(Twig)

Branch

API
Changelog
text:
Breaking

A bare name inside a @types hierarchy now declares an abstract type instead of a zero-field concrete struct, matching what a bare name already meant at the top level (@types A). Parentheses now consistently mark concrete types: use Name() or Name{T}() for a zero-field struct. A bare name still inherits the parent’s type parameters when it declares none.



Fixes

A custom docstring placed before a nested > group or a bare name is no longer silently discarded; it is attached to the generated abstract type.

title: Changelog
text:
v0.2.4 - 2026-04-16

Features

Add computed constructors to @types: new syntax Name(args...) = new(field::T = expr, ...) lets struct fields differ from constructor arguments. Works standalone, with <: subtypes, in hierarchies, parametric types, and mutable variants.

title: Changelog
text:
v0.2.3 - 2026-04-09

Fixes

Fix method overwrite error when using @mutable with @const fields and default values (keyword constructor now uses all-keyword args to avoid dispatch overlap)

title: Changelog
text:
v0.2.2 - 2026-04-09

Fixes

Fix parametric types with default values or keyword arguments (outer constructors with where clauses for proper type inference)

title: Changelog
text:
v0.2.1 - 2026-04-07

Features

Support bare parametric subtypes in @types hierarchies (e.g. Multi{T} as a child type)
Support extending existing abstract types in @types hierarchies

title: Changelog
text:
v0.2.0 - 2026-04-07

Features

Add autoshow support (automatic display of type hierarchies)
Add auto-generated and user-defined docstrings to @types hierarchies



Breaking

Remove @show_types macro (replaced by autoshow)

title: Changelog
text:
v0.1.0 - 2026-03-25

Features

Add @qtype macro for defining structs with positional constructors
Add @abstract macro for defining abstract types
Add @types macro for displaying type hierarchies
Add @mutable per-subtype and @const field annotations for mutable struct support
Add @show_types macro for displaying type hierarchies
Support default field values and keyword argument constructors



Documentation

Add README with usage examples and comparison table against similar packages
Add package comparison table with per-package code examples and source line counts
